title: ID0423729-DC/Si-D/AT- [Y2 / S6 313706372004] Charger going offline again and again.
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:  The router had lost the PUK (see screenshots) I added it and restarted the station. -> Online again. Can you please look into why it keeps going offline..

and delete the failover Ethernet
